evidence: Static nesting is correct and identical to the frozen template: each gate judge is 600s, 600+600=1200 < gates 1500; scored judges are functional 9000s, polish 900s, visual 900s, 9000+900+900=10800 < scored 11100; suites total 1500+11100=12600 < verifier 13200, leaving 600s outside suite ceilings. See task/tests/{gates,scored}/*/judge.toml:4, tests/test.sh:207,213,224 and task.toml:17-27. Agent 7200s and environment build 600s are unchanged. test.sh:48-50,116-122 probes two URLs with 2s socket timeouts up to 120 attempts with 0.25s sleeps; this is not a measured fixed 30s wall deadline (blocked responses add time). Required empirical sufficiency remains unmeasured: functional has 145 criteria and a 109199-byte assembled prompt (local/configured-inspection/results.json:96-98); its P1-P10/B1-B6 include fresh contexts, role matrices, concurrent mutations and a real restart. That artifact explicitly states NO provider grade at line 2 and only establishes installed parser/schema/CLI argument launch. Its recorded tests_sha256 all match the frozen tests. local/build-agent.log and local/build-verifier.log show CACHED dependency layers, not a realistic cold-build measurement. install-lifecycle/results.json proves a finite installer/restart observation, not agent construction or complete judging duration. repair-coverage-command.json records 3.172 seconds for a scripted finite product driver, explicitly no configured score. runtime-evidence.json is absent. The current raw-evidence-index SHA256 was 8592824b072a0ee5308bd4a7bf5a364d854cf475b658778b9e36b9b9f12a244d; all 129 artifact hashes and listed matching_source_files verified. In particular configured-inspection/results.json SHA256 846bbc329dd21dae7950550587f858211460d50d6820ae5b459b52f38449b808, install-lifecycle/results.json 52b5ba96bded2e133fe4ec16117c150d46673f70ce31284169193f478c73e9f9, and repair-coverage-command.json 1a4407897db6fb05583ed017283d43e73b2d99b3d5618faea091b2fe787e12e9. Current qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md and qc/README.md forbid treating these local observations as full configured workload evidence. No executed timeout overrun is asserted; the required runtime evidence gap blocks clearance.
counterexample: Concrete unexecuted challenge: a fast app with correct ordinary requisition persistence but a dead coordinated-change feature can pass the minimal browser gate and complete a short scripted/parser smoke run; this supplies no measurement of the full B1-B6 workload or of evaluator completion. Conversely, a conforming app exposing prepare/commit through a normal multi-step wizard, independent signed-in contexts and complete financial/audit screens is permitted by functional/prompt.md:13 and 53; the configured judge must still gather all 145 independent outcomes, including fallback setup after failures, under 9000s. If discovery/repeated UI setup exhausts that budget, prompt.md:11 assigns unobserved outcomes binary zero for evaluator limitation, while test.sh:224-225 can leave the initial zero on a whole-suite timeout. Neither actual completion time nor an actual timeout for these alternatives has been measured; static arithmetic and the 3.172s finite driver cannot establish fairness between them.
suggested_fix: Obtain authorized, hash-bound full configured judge timing on the frozen candidate with per-dimension and total completion, plus realistic cold-build timing; retain canonical budgets unless measured evidence justifies an explicitly recorded authorized change below five hours, and re-freeze/review any resulting source or timeout change.
